P4310320595.name: Wiley
P4310320595.note: Publisher-level pages. Green OA embargo is 12-24 months depending on the journal; society-owned titles may set their own terms - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310319900.name: Springer Nature
P4310319900.note: Publisher-level pages; APC varies by journal (see the journal website's Open Access Fees and Funding section). Self-archiving embargo is typically up to 12 months.

P4310319798.name: Association for Computing Machinery (ACM)
P4310319798.note: ACM moved to fully open access on 2026-01-01 under the ACM Open model; APCs apply to authors at non-participating institutions. There is effectively no green-OA embargo (immediate OA). Policies are publisher-level (ACM does not publish per-journal policy pages); journal home pages are on the ACM Digital Library (dl.acm.org).

P4310311721.name: Cambridge University Press
P4310311721.note: Green OA embargo is typically 6 months (science/medical) to 12 months (humanities/social science) - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310320006.name: American Chemical Society (ACS)
P4310320006.note: Standard green OA embargo is 12 months for hybrid journals; a zero-embargo green OA option exists (see the sharing/public-access page). APC/pricing is via the ACS pricing estimator, not a flat per-journal list.

P4310320083.name: Institute of Physics (IOP)
P4310320083.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months (subscription articles). Full APC price list is downloadable from the APC page; preprints may be shared any time.

P4310320556.name: Royal Society of Chemistry
P4310320556.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months. Gold OA APCs listed on the payments page; RSC members get a 15% discount.

P4310320497.name: Microbiology Society
P4310320497.note: Green OA (self-archiving) and APC terms are on the linked publisher pages; the accepted manuscript may be deposited, and NIH-mandated deposits are allowed with zero embargo.

P4310311847.name: The Company of Biologists
P4310311847.note: Publisher-level pages covering all five journals (Development, Journal of Cell Science, Journal of Experimental Biology, Disease Models & Mechanisms, Biology Open). Self-archiving of the accepted manuscript is allowed (including zero-embargo PMC deposit for NIH compliance) where standard routes do not meet a mandate; the 12-month subscribe-to-open window applies to the three transformative journals. APCs are set per journal - see the linked Journals Gateway open-access overview.

P4310315909.name: Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press
P4310315909.note: Publisher-level pages covering the four research journals (Genes & Development, Genome Research, RNA, Learning & Memory), which are Transformative Journals. Articles become free 6 months after publication under the standard subscription route; immediate OA is available via an APC or a transformative agreement. Pre/post-prints may be self-archived; complies with NIH Public Access (6-month). No single general self-archiving page was found on cshlpress.com (per-journal terms pages exist instead), so embargo_sharing points to the CSHL Press landing page.

P4310318509.name: Cogitatio Press
P4310318509.note: Fully open access (all five journals) under CC BY with no embargo; authors retain copyright; SHERPA/RoMEO Green Publisher status. Links go to the publisher's general About page (open access + self-archiving policy) and Institutional Membership page (APC waivers for member institutions); per-journal editorial-policies pages carry the same terms.

P4310320990.name: Elsevier
P4310320990.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Preprints may be shared any time; the accepted manuscript may go in an institutional repository only after that journal's embargo, which Elsevier sets per title (see the embargo list linked from the sharing page) rather than as one blanket period. APCs also vary by journal - the pricing page links a full price list.

P4310320547.name: Taylor & Francis
P4310320547.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Green OA embargo on the accepted manuscript is typically 12 months for science, technology and medicine titles and 18 months for social sciences and humanities. A zero-embargo green option exists for authors with funder mandates - worth checking if you must deposit immediately.

P4310319847.name: Routledge (Taylor & Francis)
P4310319847.note: Routledge is a Taylor & Francis imprint and follows the same policies. Green OA embargo is typically 18 months for social sciences and humanities (most Routledge titles) and 12 months for science and medicine. A zero-embargo green option exists for funder-mandated deposits.

P4310320017.name: SAGE Publishing
P4310320017.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. The accepted version of a subscription article may be posted to an institutional repository for non-commercial, no-derivative use; embargo length is set per journal, so confirm on the journal's own page. Automatic APC waivers apply for authors in Research4Life Group A countries and 50% discounts for Group B.

P4310311648.name: Oxford University Press
P4310311648.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. The standard green OA embargo is 12 months from online publication for the accepted manuscript, but OUP runs several self-archiving policies and embargoes differ by journal - check your title on the embargo periods page before depositing.

P4310313990.name: De Gruyter Brill
P4310313990.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. The submitted preprint may be self-archived at any time; the version of record may go in a repository after a 12-month embargo for subscription and closed-access hybrid articles. Note this green route does not satisfy Plan S - publish gold if your funder requires immediate OA.

P4310320322.name: De Gruyter Open
P4310320322.note: De Gruyter's fully open access imprint, now part of De Gruyter Brill. Articles are open on publication with no embargo, so self-archiving is unrestricted. APC varies by journal.

P4310319808.name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)
P4310319808.note: Hybrid journals, fully open access topical journals, and IEEE Access. Authors may post the accepted manuscript to a personal or employer site, and green OA deposit in a funder-mandated public repository is allowed at no charge. APC is about $2,160 for fully OA titles and $2,800 for hybrid, with IEEE member discounts.

P4310319811.name: Emerald Publishing
P4310319811.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Emerald has offered zero-embargo green OA since 2014: the accepted manuscript may be deposited immediately on publication under CC BY-NC at no charge, which satisfies most funder mandates without an APC. CC BY on the accepted manuscript requires a paid APC or an institutional agreement.

P4310315671.name: Lippincott Williams & Wilkins (Wolters Kluwer)
P4310315671.note: Mostly subscription and hybrid medical journals. Green OA embargo on the accepted manuscript is 12 months where the journal offers an open access option and 6 months where it does not, deposited under CC BY-NC. LWW deposits NIH-funded articles to PubMed Central on the author's behalf.

P4310320256.name: BioMed Central (Springer Nature)
P4310320256.note: Fully open access. Articles publish immediately open under CC BY with authors retaining copyright, so there is no embargo and self-archiving is unrestricted. Eligible articles are deposited to PubMed Central automatically. APC varies by journal; waivers exist for member institutions and demonstrated hardship.

P4310310987.name: MDPI
P4310310987.note: Fully open access. All articles publish immediately under CC BY with no embargo, and authors retain copyright without signing a transfer, so any version may be deposited in a repository at any time. APC varies by journal; discounts and waivers are available.

P4310320527.name: Frontiers Media
P4310320527.note: Fully open access. Articles publish immediately under CC BY with authors retaining copyright, so there is no embargo on self-archiving. Publishing fees vary by journal and article type and are payable only on acceptance; discounts are available for authors in low and lower-middle income countries.

P4310319869.name: Hindawi (Wiley)
P4310319869.note: All Hindawi journals are fully open access, now published under Wiley. Articles are open on publication, so there is no embargo on self-archiving. APCs apply per journal, with automatic Research4Life waivers and discounts for authors in low- and middle-income countries.

P4310320561.name: Brill (De Gruyter Brill)
P4310320561.note: Hybrid journals, now part of De Gruyter Brill. Hybrid gold OA carries an APC of about EUR 2,400 with authors retaining copyright under CC BY; institutional agreements can cover it. The green route is free: the version of record may be self-archived after a 12-month embargo.

P4310317820.name: Karger Publishers
P4310317820.note: Hybrid and fully open access biomedical journals. Preprints may be shared without restriction; the accepted manuscript may go in a public repository after a 12-month embargo (or as the funder requires), and non-commercial posting to a personal page or institutional repository is permitted. APC varies by journal, roughly EUR 3,800-4,400 at the top end.

P4310320262.name: American Psychological Association (APA)
P4310320262.note: Subscription and hybrid journals with green and gold routes. APA's posting guidelines allow the accepted manuscript on personal sites, institutional repositories, PsyArXiv, and author networks with no embargo, provided the copyright notice and a DOI link to the version of record are included. Gold OA via APC or an institutional Read-and-Publish agreement.

P4310319815.name: World Scientific
P4310319815.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals. Preprints may be posted anywhere at any time; the accepted manuscript may go in a repository 12 months after publication. Gold OA (CC BY or CC BY-NC) removes the embargo entirely and authors retain copyright. APC varies by journal.

P4310321135.name: Georg Thieme Verlag
P4310321135.note: Hybrid and fully open access medical journals. Open access articles may be deposited anywhere immediately under their CC license; for subscription articles the accepted manuscript may go in a non-commercial institutional repository no earlier than 12 months after publication. Complies with the NIH Public Access Policy.

P4310320000.name: Thieme Medical Publishers
P4310320000.note: Part of the Thieme Group; same policies as Georg Thieme Verlag. OA articles may be deposited immediately; subscription-article accepted manuscripts carry a 12-month embargo for institutional repositories. Complies with the NIH Public Access Policy.

P4310320443.name: Mary Ann Liebert, Inc.
P4310320443.note: Hybrid and fully open access journals with a notably permissive green route: the accepted manuscript may be posted to an institutional repository, funder repository, or personal website immediately on publication, with no embargo and no charge. APCs apply only if you choose gold OA; Research4Life waivers and discounts available.

P4310320448.name: Medknow (Wolters Kluwer)
P4310320448.note: Open access society journals, mostly from medical societies in India and Asia. Most titles charge no APC and provide immediate free access to full text; self-archiving is permitted. Policies vary by journal - confirm on the journal's own page.

P4310319908.name: Nature Portfolio (Springer Nature)
P4310319908.note: Nature-branded subscription, hybrid, and fully OA journals. Subscription-route authors may self-archive the accepted manuscript on a personal site or in funder/institutional repositories for public release 6 months after publication. Gold OA (CC BY, APC varies by journal) removes the embargo.

P4310315672.name: University of Chicago Press
P4310315672.note: Subscription and hybrid journals with portfolio-wide green OA: the accepted manuscript or published PDF may be deposited in a non-commercial repository and made freely available 12 months after publication; funder mandates with shorter embargoes are honored for the accepted manuscript only. Each journal has its own 'Open Access at Chicago' page - check it for gold OA fees.

P4310317825.name: Inderscience Publishers
P4310317825.note: Subscription journals with a gold OA option (APC around EUR 2,200-3,300). OA authors retain copyright under CC BY and may post the version of record to non-commercial repositories with no embargo. For non-OA articles, check the copyright page for what may be shared.

P4310320348.name: Dove Medical Press (Taylor & Francis)
P4310320348.note: Fully open access medical journals, part of Taylor & Francis. Articles publish immediately under CC BY-NC (CC BY available for certain funders) with authors retaining copyright, so there is no embargo. APC varies by journal; full waivers and 50% discounts apply for authors in low-income economies.

P4310319748.name: EDP Sciences
P4310319748.note: Society-owned journals, many fully OA or under Subscribe-to-Open. Green OA is unusually generous: all versions (submitted, accepted, and version of record) may be deposited in institutional or subject repositories without embargo, under the article's license. Publication charges vary by journal.

P4310320424.name: IGI Global
P4310320424.note: Open access and hybrid journals, including diamond OA titles with no APC. OA articles publish under CC BY 4.0 with authors keeping copyright; the fair-use policy also lets authors post the final typeset PDF on a personal site or university repository. Where funders require it, the accepted manuscript may be deposited under CC BY.

P4310320402.name: John Benjamins Publishing Company
P4310320402.note: Hybrid linguistics journals. The submitted manuscript may be posted anywhere at any time; the accepted manuscript may go on a personal site, institutional or funder repository, and preprint servers after the version of record publishes. Gold OA APC is about EUR 1,800, waived under Read-and-Publish agreements.

P4310320079.name: Bentham Science Publishers
P4310320079.note: Subscription journals with a gold OA option (Open Access Plus) plus some fully OA titles. The accepted manuscript may be deposited on a personal site, institutional repository, PMC, or arXiv 12 months after publication; gold OA articles have no embargo. The final published version may only be archived under a funder mandate.

P4310311755.name: Intellect
P4310311755.note: Arts and media journals, mostly hybrid, with some diamond OA titles that charge no APC. Green self-archiving is supported, typically with an embargo for subscription articles - the OA FAQs page covers routes, fees, and the self-archiving policy. Confirm your journal's terms on its own page.

P4310320267.name: Pleiades Publishing
P4310320267.note: English-language editions of Russian-origin journals, distributed via Springer. Non-OA authors transfer exclusive rights to the publisher, so sharing is mainly via links to the published article; gold OA articles publish under CC BY with no embargo. Check the license page before depositing anything in a repository.

P4310315823.name: American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS)
P4310315823.note: No green OA embargo: authors of peer-reviewed research may deposit the accepted manuscript in any repository immediately on publication, and AAAS makes all research articles free to read 12 months after publication. Science Advances is fully gold OA (base APC $5,450, CC BY or CC BY-NC, hardship discounts available); Science and the other four Science-family journals are subscription-only with green OA and no hybrid OA fee.

P4310320259.name: American Medical Association (JAMA Network)
P4310320259.note: No green OA embargo on deposit: authors of original research may deposit the accepted manuscript in any repository on the date of acceptance, released publicly on the publication date. The published version is free to read after 6 months (JAMA) or 12 months (specialty journals) and appears in PMC. JAMA Network Open and JAMA Health Forum are fully gold OA ($4,000 APC); the specialty journals are hybrid ($6,000 APC, research articles only), with Research4Life country waivers.

P4310320257.name: American Institute of Physics (AIP Publishing)
P4310320257.note: No green OA embargo: the accepted manuscript may be self-archived immediately on acceptance at no cost. Gold OA fees are $1,800 for AIP Advances and $2,750 for other gold titles; subscription journals offer the hybrid Author Select option, and several titles (e.g. Matter and Radiation at Extremes) are diamond OA with no author charge. The APC details sit in the 'Publication Charges & Gold Open Access Fees' section of the open-access page.

P4310320261.name: American Physical Society (APS)
P4310320261.note: Physical Review X, PRX Quantum, PRX Energy and Physical Review Research are fully gold OA; the other Physical Review titles are hybrid. Authors may post the author-prepared accepted manuscript on arXiv or an institutional repository at any time (not the APS version of record); for funder-compliance deposits a 12-month embargo has applied, and APS has a pilot allowing immediate green deposit from hybrid titles for articles accepted from 1 January 2027. Per-journal APC amounts are on the linked page.

P4310315543.name: SPIE
P4310315543.note: No green OA embargo: SPIE's long-standing green policy lets authors post the accepted manuscript (not the published version) in institutional or subject repositories immediately, and preprints on servers such as arXiv. Journals are hybrid, with a smaller gold APC than most publishers; read-and-publish agreements can waive it. SPIE's site blocks automated fetches, so open the links in a browser.

P4310315679.name: Optica Publishing Group
P4310315679.note: Optica, Optics Express, Biomedical Optics Express and Optical Materials Express are fully gold OA; Applied Optics, Optics Letters and JOSA A/B are subscription titles with an OA option. Green OA on subscription titles carries a 12-month embargo on the accepted manuscript. APCs vary by journal and article length; institutional OA agreements can cover them. Optica's site is behind bot protection, so open the links in a browser.

P4310316053.name: American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME)
P4310316053.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months: the accepted manuscript may go into a funder or institutional repository for public release 12 months after publication, with ASME permission (permissions@asme.org). ASME journals are hybrid at a $3,000 APC; ASME Open Journal of Engineering is gold ($1,700 members / $1,950 non-members) and conference papers are $1,500. NOTE: OpenAlex files a handful of ASM International materials titles (Alloy Digest, Journal of Phase Equilibria and Diffusion, Journal of Thermal Spray Technology) under this same publisher id; ASM International's journals are published by Springer Nature, so use Springer's policies for those - see https://www.asminternational.org/materials-resources/journals/

P4310311714.name: Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET)
P4310311714.note: All 40+ IET journals are now open access - most gold, with an APC that varies by title. No green OA embargo: authors may deposit any version in a repository of their choice immediately. IET journals are published on Wiley Online Library, so Wiley's self-archiving page and Wiley transformative agreements apply; IET members get 15% off APCs and low-income-country waivers are available.

P4310317839.name: Trans Tech Publications
P4310317839.note: Materials and mechanical engineering book-series journals (Advanced Materials Research, Applied Mechanics and Materials, Key Engineering Materials, Materials Science Forum). Titles are subscription with a paid OA option; APCs and self-archiving terms vary by series, and read-and-publish agreements with partner institutions can waive the charge. Confirm the terms for your specific series on the linked pages before relying on them.

P4310320226.name: Acoustical Society of America (ASA)
P4310320226.note: ASA journals are published on AIP Publishing's platform, so AIP's open-access and green-OA terms apply: the accepted manuscript may be self-archived immediately, with no embargo. JASA is hybrid (OA option $2,600); JASA Express Letters is gold ($1,450, $1,100 for ASA members). ASA's own web-posting guidelines govern what version may be posted where.

P4310315719.name: American Mathematical Society (AMS)
P4310315719.note: No green OA embargo: authors may post the accepted pre-publication version on a personal page, a non-commercial institutional repository, or arXiv immediately. AMS version-of-record articles open automatically five years after publication. Two gold OA titles - Proceedings of the AMS Series B and Transactions of the AMS Series B - carry an APC; the rest are subscription. ams.org blocks automated fetches, so open the link in a browser.

P4310320508.name: Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (SIAM)
P4310320508.note: SIAM journals are subscription with a voluntary OA option: a one-time APC (about $3,750, selected on the Consent to Publish form) makes the published version CC BY. SIAM otherwise holds copyright; posting rights for the accepted manuscript are set out in the Consent to Publish agreement and the author information page. siam.org itself blocks automated fetches - use the epubs.siam.org author page.

P4310320255.name: American Astronomical Society (AAS)
P4310320255.note: Fully gold OA since 1 January 2022 - every AAS article, past and present, is immediately free to read under CC BY, so there is no embargo and green OA is moot. APCs are calculated per article from 'digital quanta' (words, figures, tables): roughly $1,149-$2,599 for the Astronomical Journal / ApJ / ApJS and about $2,400 for ApJ Letters. Waivers and discounts are available. Published for AAS by IOP Publishing.

P4310315747.name: American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE)
P4310315747.note: ASCE's specialty journals are hybrid (OA option about $2,500); ASCE OPEN: Multidisciplinary Journal of Civil Engineering is fully gold (about $2,000). Green OA: authors may post their own post-peer-review, pre-copyediting version to a repository under ASCE's publication agreement, but not the publisher's formatted PDF. Check the agreement for the embargo that applies to your journal.

P4310315809.name: American Geophysical Union (AGU)
P4310315809.note: AGU journals are published by Wiley, so Wiley's self-archiving page and transformative agreements apply. About a dozen AGU titles are fully gold OA (including Geophysical Research Letters, Earth's Future, Water Resources Research, Space Weather); the rest are hybrid, where an article that doesn't pay an APC stays behind the paywall for 24 months. Authors may archive the accepted version in a preprint server or institutional repository at no charge. APCs vary by journal (GRL was about $3,440). agu.org blocks automated fetches - open the links in a browser.

P4310320260.name: American Meteorological Society (AMS)
P4310320260.note: AMS technical journals are subscription-based with page charges (about $120 per typeset page) plus an optional Open Choice fee for immediate OA; AI for Earth Systems and Earth Interactions are fully gold, and all peer-reviewed BAMS articles are free to read. AMS content opens to the public after a delay - see the public-access page for the current window - and read-and-publish agreements can cover author costs. ametsoc.org blocks automated fetches; open the links in a browser.

P4310319845.name: Geological Society of America (GSA)
P4310319845.note: Hybrid: Geosphere is 100% gold (about $1,750, $200 less for GSA members); Geology, GSA Bulletin and GSA Books offer a gold option (about $2,800, $500 less for members). Green OA with no embargo - authors may post the accepted, post-peer-review version, with a link to the published article, in any repository or personal site. Waivers exist; no paper is rejected for inability to pay.

P4310313756.name: Copernicus Publications
P4310313756.note: All Copernicus journals are fully gold OA under CC BY, so there is no embargo and no subscription - authors retain copyright and may post any version anywhere. APCs are set per journal (many are length-based) and are listed on the APC information page; several journals run an interactive public peer review in which the discussion paper is open from submission.

P4310320302.name: CSIRO Publishing
P4310320302.note: Australian society and agency journals (Australian Journal of Chemistry, Marine and Freshwater Research, Animal Production Science, Functional Plant Biology). Mostly hybrid with a gold OA option; a few titles are fully OA. Journals moved to the ConnectSci platform, so the open-access page there carries the current APC amounts, licence choices and self-archiving terms - confirm the embargo for your specific journal.

P4310313060.name: Canadian Science Publishing (NRC Research Press)
P4310313060.note: Formerly NRC Research Press; publishes the Canadian Journal of Chemistry / Physics / Earth Sciences / Microbiology and related titles. Seven journals are fully gold OA; the rest are hybrid. No green OA embargo in practice: authors keep copyright and may post the preprint and the accepted manuscript in any institutional or subject repository at no cost, with no embargo for PubMed Central, and Plan S authors may deposit with an open licence.

P4310320555.name: International Union of Crystallography (IUCr)
P4310320555.note: IUCrJ, Acta Cryst. E and IUCrData are fully gold OA; the other Acta Crystallographica sections are hybrid. Authors are not asked to transfer copyright. No embargo on the accepted manuscript - it may be posted on a personal site, an employer's repository or a not-for-profit subject repository with attribution and a link to the published article. OA fees are per journal (Acta Cryst. E about USD 590, IUCrJ about USD 2,540, IUCrData about USD 340); Wiley read-and-publish agreements may cover them. iucr.org blocks automated fetches.

P4310320195.name: The Electrochemical Society (ECS)
P4310320195.note: ECS journals are published on IOPscience under the 'Free the Science' programme. Green OA with no embargo: authors may share their ECS article immediately without an OA credit or an APC. The standard gold APC is about $1,000, but ECS's Author Choice programme and ECS Plus read-and-publish subscriptions have made most ECS OA articles free to the author.

P4310320373.name: Annual Reviews
P4310320373.note: No APC at all: Annual Reviews runs Subscribe to Open, where library subscriptions convert each new volume to OA (CC BY-NC-ND) if support is sufficient. Reviews are invited, so authors are never billed. Self-archiving is restricted - authors may post a preprint to an institutional repository and share the publisher-supplied ePrint link, but are asked not to post the published PDF publicly. annualreviews.org blocks automated fetches.

P4310318577.name: IOS Press (Sage)
P4310318577.note: Acquired by Sage in 2024: from 8 July 2024 IOS Press follows Sage's article-sharing and archiving guidelines, so green OA terms and embargo lengths are Sage's. Most titles are hybrid via the Open Library programme (APC generally about EUR 900 / USD 1,250); some are fully gold. Institutional agreements can waive or discount the fee.

P4310320565.name: Chemical Society of Japan (CSJ)
P4310320565.note: The Bulletin of the Chemical Society of Japan and Chemistry Letters are published for CSJ by Oxford University Press, so OUP's open-access, embargo and APC pages govern them. Both are open access under CC BY with an APC; corresponding authors who are CSJ members get a discount. Confirm the per-title embargo on OUP's embargo-periods page.

P4310313296.name: Physical Society of Japan (JPS)
P4310313296.note: Journal of the Physical Society of Japan is subscription-based with the OPEN SELECT paid OA option (CC BY 4.0 since June 2016); no page charge for papers up to 10 printed pages, with a per-page charge from page 11. Articles may be posted in an institutional repository under the conditions on the JPS copyright page, which set an embargo that does not apply to CC BY OPEN SELECT articles.

P4310315709.name: American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA)
P4310315709.note: All AIAA journals moved to a hybrid gold model in 2016: a voluntary article processing fee (about $2,600, 10% off for AIAA members) opens the version of record immediately on Aerospace Research Central. Green OA since 2012 with no embargo - authors may post the submitted conference paper or the final accepted journal manuscript on a personal site or in an institutional or subject repository, but not AIAA's published PDF.

P4310319945.name: BMJ
P4310319945.note: BMJ runs both fully open access journals (BMJ Open, BMJ Global Health, BMJ Open Quality and others) and hybrid titles. The open-access page carries publication charges, waivers and discounts, open-access agreements and licence options in one place; green OA terms and any embargo depend on the title, so check the copyright and author rights page for yours.

P4310315706.name: Public Library of Science (PLOS)
P4310315706.note: Every PLOS journal is fully gold OA under CC BY, so there is no embargo and no green-OA question - authors keep copyright and may post any version anywhere. Fees vary by journal and by model (flat APC, Community Action Publishing, or a global equity tier); PLOS also has institutional agreements and a publication fee assistance programme.

P4310320239.name: Massachusetts Medical Society (NEJM)
P4310320239.note: The New England Journal of Medicine is subscription-based with no author-pays OA option for research articles. Green OA: authors may deposit the NEJM-supplied accepted manuscript PDF in a non-commercial repository after publication under a CC BY-NC-ND licence, and for NIH, Wellcome or similar funded work NEJM deposits the published PDF to PMC or Europe PMC for release six months after publication. Preprints are accepted if disclosed at submission.

P4310320052.name: National Academy of Sciences (PNAS)
P4310320052.note: PNAS is hybrid: every article is free to read six months after publication, and an APC buys immediate OA (roughly $4,975-$5,475 for a research article, less for Brief Reports) under CC BY or CC BY-NC-ND. No green OA embargo - since 2004 authors may deposit the accepted manuscript in a funder archive or non-commercial institutional repository immediately on publication, under the article's licence and with a link back to PNAS.

P4310320263.name: American Society for Microbiology (ASM)
P4310320263.note: ASM publishes fully open access titles (mBio, mSystems, mSphere, Microbiology Spectrum) alongside hybrid ones (Journal of Bacteriology, Journal of Virology, Applied and Environmental Microbiology, Antimicrobial Agents and Chemotherapy). The open-access policy page states the licence, embargo and deposit terms; APCs and any member or institutional discounts are in the author center.

P4310320273.name: American Association for Cancer Research (AACR)
P4310320273.note: AACR journals are hybrid with an OA option; the 'Open Access, Free Access, and Article Archiving' page sets out the OA routes, the free-access delay on subscription content, and the repository/archiving terms (including PMC deposit for funded work). APC amounts and member discounts are in the information-for-authors pages.

P4310320155.name: American Physiological Society (APS)
P4310320155.note: Hybrid: the American Journal of Physiology titles, Journal of Applied Physiology and Journal of Neurophysiology are subscription with a paid OA option, alongside the fully OA titles Function and Physiological Reports. The open-access page explains how APS helps authors meet funder public-access requirements; the publication fees page lists current APCs and member rates.

P4310311608.name: Portland Press (Biochemical Society)
P4310311608.note: Publisher for the Biochemical Society: Biochemical Journal, Biochemical Society Transactions, Clinical Science, Bioscience Reports. A mix of fully OA and hybrid titles; the open-access policy page covers licences, self-archiving and embargo terms, and the options-and-prices page lists current APCs and Read & Publish arrangements.

P4310319787.name: The Royal Society
P4310319787.note: Royal Society Open Science, Open Biology and Biology Letters are fully OA; Proceedings A/B and the Philosophical Transactions are hybrid, with several titles moving to Subscribe to Open. The open-access page lists APCs, waivers and Read & Publish agreements; the journal policies page covers licensing, self-archiving and embargo terms.

P4310316602.name: American Psychiatric Association Publishing
P4310316602.note: Publisher of the American Journal of Psychiatry, Psychiatric Services and FOCUS. Titles are subscription-based with an author-pays OA option on research articles; the copyright page states the licence and posting terms and the reprints-and-permissions page routes fee and reuse requests. Confirm the current APC and any green-OA embargo with the journal before depositing.

P4310315734.name: American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP)
P4310315734.note: Pediatrics and Hospital Pediatrics are hybrid, offering one green and two gold licence options (CC BY and CC BY-NC-ND); Pediatrics Open Science is fully gold (APC up to about $2,950, $500 for trainees). AAP members get 15% off and Research4Life authors get a full or 50% discount. Check the licensing page for the green-OA version and embargo that apply to your article.

P4310320274.name: American Diabetes Association (ADA)
P4310320274.note: Diabetes, Diabetes Care and Clinical Diabetes are subscription titles with an 'Open Choice' paid OA option (roughly $3,000-$4,000 depending on article type); Diabetes Spectrum and BMJ Open Diabetes Research & Care are open. ADA deposits NIH- and other US-government-funded articles into PubMed Central at no cost to the author, publicly available immediately on publication under the 2025 NIH policy.

P4310315676.name: Rockefeller University Press
P4310315676.note: Journal of Cell Biology, Journal of Experimental Medicine and Journal of General Physiology. Long-standing policy of releasing subscription content free to read after a short delay, plus a paid immediate-OA option under a Creative Commons licence; the publication fees and access options page carries the current charges, licences and deposit terms.

P4310316283.name: American Society for Pharmacology and Experimental Therapeutics (ASPET)
P4310316283.note: Journal of Pharmacology and Experimental Therapeutics, Molecular Pharmacology, Drug Metabolism and Disposition and Pharmacological Reviews. Since January 2023 page charges are waived for authors who opt into OA; APCs are about $3,000 (CC BY) or $2,000 (CC BY-NC) for members and $3,500 / $2,500 for non-members, with an Open Access License Agreement replacing copyright transfer. ASPET has only a single society-level journals page, so confirm the current licence, fee and any embargo on the individual journal's site.

P4310316812.name: American College of Physicians (ACP)
P4310316812.note: Annals of Internal Medicine is subscription-based and does NOT offer an article-level author-pays OA option; authors get broad reuse rights after publication without asking permission, content is free in developing economies, and ACP supports NIH public-access deposit. ACP's separate open access journal, Annals of Internal Medicine: Clinical Cases, does charge an APC (about $743 for ACP/AHA members, $990 otherwise).

P4310315931.name: Radiological Society of North America (RSNA)
P4310315931.note: Radiology and RadioGraphics are hybrid with a paid immediate-OA option; Radiology: Artificial Intelligence, Radiology: Cardiothoracic Imaging and the other Radiology sub-journals are fully open. The open-access policy page states the licences, the free-access delay on subscription articles and the repository deposit terms; author services carries the current charges.

P4310316311.name: American Thoracic Society (ATS)
P4310316311.note: ATS journals (AJRCCM, AJRCMB, AnnalsATS, ATS Scholar) are now published on Oxford Academic, so OUP's open-access, self-archiving and embargo pages govern them. Titles are hybrid with a gold option; the standard OUP green embargo is 12 months but differs by journal - check the embargo-periods page for yours.
